It appears that P17 is unavailable. In that case, I will escalate the issue by creating an alert in PagerDuty to notify the on-call team. I will also check the status of the Postgres server and the read replica to ensure they are functioning properly.

If the issue persists, I will look into alternate methods to gather the required data, such as manually querying the primary database or checking the logs for the jobs service.

Once I have the data and have taken the necessary actions, I will submit my findings and recommended next steps using the `submit_report` function when P17 becomes available.
